applies_why: The judge found UNDERDETERMINED because the text does not name whose body is the channel, which is treating a verse's silence as a ground for UNDERDETERMINED.
quote: the text names the seed of David 'according to the flesh' without naming whose body is the channel, so the point stays open.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED: read as barring UNDERDETERMINED when the only reason is the verse's silence about whose body is the channel, versus read as allowing UNDERDETERMINED when the verse leaves the channel unnamed.
why: The judge's stated reason is the absence of a named channel in the text, a ground K-S2 forbids for UNDERDETERMINED.
